parameters.instructions:
Procurement assistant server (prototype).

Typical flow:
1. create_rfq - log the buyer's request and get an rfq_id.
2. find_suppliers - pull approved suppliers for that spend category.
3. recommend_supplier - pass those supplier rows in to get a ranked recommendation.

list_rfqs reads back everything logged so far. All data lives in one Google Sheet with a 'Suppliers' tab and an 'RFQs' tab. Always confirm quantity and needed_by with the user before creating an RFQ.

parameters.toolDescription: Create a new Request For Quotation (RFQ) and log it as a row in the RFQs sheet. Use this when a user asks to raise, open, or submit a purchase request. Returns the row that was written, including the generated rfq_id.

Look up approved suppliers in the Suppliers sheet, filtered by spend category. Returns each supplier's unit_price, lead_time_days, rating, on_time_rate, min_order_qty and contact. Call this before recommend_supplier.

parameters.description: Rank candidate suppliers and recommend one, using a weighted score over unit price, lead time, rating and on-time delivery rate. Pass the rows returned by find_suppliers. Returns the recommended supplier, a plain-language rationale, and the full ranking with score breakdowns.

parameters.toolDescription: Read every RFQ currently logged in the RFQs sheet. Use this to check the status of past requests or to find an rfq_id.
